title: Shani Sade Sati Explained: Myths, Facts and Practical Advice
intro: Few words worry people as much as Sade Sati. It is described as seven and a half years of Saturn's influence, but traditional texts present it as a period of lessons, not just trouble.

p: In Vedic astrology, Sade Sati occurs when Saturn passes through the sign before your Moon sign, the Moon sign itself and the sign after it. Saturn spends about two and a half years in each, which gives seven and a half years.
Saturn is linked with discipline, delay and karma. This period is believed to bring responsibilities and tests. Not everyone experiences it the same way, and results depend on the whole chart.

Praying to Hanuman or Lord Shiva, chanting a Shani mantra on Saturdays, lighting a sesame oil lamp, and helping the poor or the elderly are the usual remedies. In the Bhavishya Purana, the sage Pippalada is remembered on Saturdays for relief from Shani's troubles.
Whatever one believes, a long phase of responsibility is easier with good habits: regular work, honesty, a steady budget, and looking after your health. These help in any period of life.

faq.q: How long does Sade Sati last?
faq.a: About seven and a half years, in three phases of roughly two and a half years.
Traditional texts say results vary, and some people find it a period of growth.

disclaimer: Note: astrology is a belief system. Do not make medical, legal or financial decisions based only on it.
